title: File:Laguna Huenfuica y Volcán Lanín.jpg
claims: A snow-capped Lanín volcano across Laguna Huenfuica, with araucaria trees, fallen logs and a sandy shore in the foreground; the Commons description places the photograph in Villarrica National Park. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Laguna Huenfuica y Volcán Lanín.jpg. The route page uses it as a Lanín volcano regional landmark near the Patagonia Run theatre; it was taken in Villarrica National Park, not on the Patagonia Run course, and does not show the 2027 route.

The Commons author field reads Rodrigo Yuraszeck; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2019-01-31 12:45:56; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 5,312 × 2,988 px; 7,246,076 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 540 px; 204,016 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Rodrigo Yuraszeck, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
